reviewHistory.finding: The validator was tautological and Channel Resource semantics had no owner.

acceptanceCriteria: Two materially different domains catch tenant, collaboration, mutable-CRUD, and membership-only assumptions.

Every accepted compiler, type, migration, Context, Policy, Operation, lifecycle, realtime, durable, Route, HA, optional-capability, File, Search, projection, envelope, managed-PostgreSQL, and performance contract has an owned conformance cell.
Direct, network, worker, recompute, and Studio parity is explicit where applicable.
Correctness, microbenchmark, load, and soak evidence remain separate and implementation slices own measured budgets.
PostgreSQL remains durable authority, the Index remains B-tree-only, and no RLS claim is introduced.
V3 tests are behavioral evidence and their organization, provider matrices, and slow loop are not ported.
No production QUESTPIE Runtime is implemented.
